seo.title: Pricing · Servicely™ (demo)
seo.description: Demo pricing page. The prices are fictional, just like the company. This is a template — handy for showing a SaaS plan layout.

data.headline: # Pricing made *simple.*
data.lead: One number per plan. No quotes, no add-ons, no enterprise tier hidden behind a contact form. (The numbers below are made up too — this is a demo.)

plans.name: Solo
plans.pitch: For one person on one project. Free forever — or until investors change their minds.

plans.name: Team
plans.pitch: For teams that ship every day. Branch previews, role-based access, an AI agent.

plans.name: Studio
plans.pitch: For agencies and platform teams running many client sites at once.

entries.question: What counts as an editor seat?
entries.answer: Anyone who logs into the editor and works with bookings. Developers reading via the API don't count. AI agents don't count (yet).

entries.question: Is there a free trial of Team?
entries.answer: Yes — 14 days, no card required. You can keep using Solo indefinitely if Team isn't the right fit.

entries.question: Can I self-host?
entries.answer: The runtime, yes — MIT-licensed. The visual editor is a hosted service for now. Self-host for Studio is on the roadmap, and this time we'll actually ship it.

entries.question: How does AI billing work?
entries.answer: You bring your own API key (Anthropic, OpenAI, in-house). Servicely doesn't mark up tokens or charge per generation. You pay exactly what your provider charges.

entries.question: Do you do annual discounts?
entries.answer: Yes — pay annually, get two months free. No haggling, same number for everyone. (We don't have a sales team to haggle with anyway.)

entries.question: What if I outgrow 500k bookings?
entries.answer: You stay on Team and pay $0.20 per additional 1k bookings. We email you the day you cross — no 'surprise' invoice at month-end.

entries.question: Can I cancel anytime?
entries.answer: Yes. No multi-year contracts, no clawback clauses. Your data exports cleanly to JSON in one click.

data.headline: ## Still unsure? *Talk to a human.*
data.lead: No SDR queue. You'll get a founder on the call. With a bit of luck, the founder's dog.
